//_note: STUDY DATA — the one intermediate file record_set_to_sdtm.py needs besides the record set.
//_note_2: Holds what BCOs and BMKB records must never carry: demographics and result values. It is not a deliverable; keep it with the SDTM output, never with the BCOs.
//_note_3: Build it from the lab and demographics files. Their headers will not match SDTM: map each column yourself and list the mapping in the hand-over report.
//_claim_help: The biomarker claim, from the context-of-use document. One BM row is written per BEST role in the BMKB record; ids after the first increment (BM-001, BM-002, ...).

evidence: PLACEHOLDER - as the documents give it: a PMID or DOI if they cite one, otherwise the citation text

//_dm_help: One entry per subject. Use CDISC CT: AGEU 'YEARS', SEX 'M'/'F'/'U', COUNTRY ISO 3166-1 alpha-3. Leave a field out (or null) when the documents lack it; never guess.

dm.usubjid: PLACEHOLDER - matches assay_run_extension.usubjid in that subject's rBCO

//_results_help: One entry per rBCO measurement, matched on (usubjid, specimen_id). 'result' is exactly as the lab reported it, operator included ('<0.006'). The converter checks it against the rBCO censor_state.

results.unit: PLACEHOLDER - as the lab reports it; must be the tBCO unit or a CDISC synonym of it (ng/mL for ug/L)
